question: Should Claude prepaid balance replace the existing Claude spend/cap presentation when both values are available, or should both values remain visible?
rationale: The implementation intentionally changes the primary user-visible meaning of the Claude cost row, and tests establish the proposed behavior but do not establish repository product direction for that upgrade.

options.title: Show prepaid balance only
options.body: Accept the PR’s proposed Credits-first display, with the balance treated as the useful user-facing value when it is available.

options.title: Show both values
options.body: Retain spend/cap alongside Credits so existing users do not lose the prior extra-usage context.

recommendation.title: Show prepaid balance only
recommendation.body: Accept the PR’s proposed Credits-first display, with the balance treated as the useful user-facing value when it is available.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a user-visible product and upgrade-choice decision rather than a narrow mechanical defect.
